case_number: 2025 INSC 413; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 (ARISING FROM SLP(Crl.) No. 12249 OF 2023)
summary: Irretrievable breakdown of marriage after 17 years separation; divorce granted under Article 142; parties separated since December 2007; no marital restitution possible; maintenance disputes: Rs 5,000 under CrPC 125 and Rs 15,000 under DV Act; financial claims: wife sought Rs 10.01 lakhs maintenance arrears, husband declared Rs 8 lakhs; current earnings disputed; permanent alimony set at Rs 40 lakhs; one-time settlement covering all monetary claims; directed payment in four equal monthly installments.
legal_provisions_cited: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order set aside; marriage dissolved; decree of divorce granted; permanent alimony of Rs 40 lakhs awarded; directed payment within 4 months in 4 equal installments; first installment due within one month; registry to draw decree only after payment proof.
